thread:
maya: heads up — after last night's driver rollout we're seeing a perf regression on long sequences (512+). 95p latency jumped ~2.8x for some customers. anyone else seeing kernel selector noise?

liam: saw alerts, digging. initial hunch: seqlen binning change caused a kernel mismatch for avx64 hosts.

sophia: reprod locally on emu32, i see the same. kernel_picker is returning `fallback_generic` for inputs that used to pick `avx_fused_v2`.

maya: yup. logs show this around the KV lookup step where we compute the hotkey cohort. suspect keying salt mismatch between driver and runtime.

perf-bot: [perf-regression] service=runtime path=/predict 95p_latency=242.8ms → 684.1ms ; increased error_rate 0.7% :rotating_light:

liam: snippet from runtime logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:11Z] kernel_picker: seqlen=512 arch=avx64 cohort=hotkey-03 -> fallback_generic
[2026-03-17T03:12:11Z] kv_cache: lookup key="sess:avx64:hotkey-03:v2" not_found
[2026-03-17T03:12:11Z] kv_cache: fallback_load kvcache_bucket=legacy
```

ashley: deploy-bot shows driver roll v1.21.0 -> v1.22.0 rolled at 02:58:00 UTC across us-west-2.

deploy-bot: rollout complete — driver v1.22.0 deployed to pool=avx64-primary (id: pool-42) by @ashley

maya: that aligns. v1.22 changed the seqlen bin boundaries to improve batching efficiency, but looks like we missed the key-salting migration in the autotuner. result: runtime still persisting keys with old salt, driver expecting salted keys -> miss -> fallback kernel chosen.

sophia: confirmed. forcing the old kernel pick in picker_config fixes latency in canary. quick patch: pin seqlen_bin_map to pre-rollout.

liam: temp mitigation options: 1) rollback driver to v1.21.0 2) patch runtime to accept both salt formats in KV lookup 3) backfill persisted keys with new salted namespace (longer)

maya: for immediate SLO restore we should rollback the driver in affected pools (us-west-2 avx64). then we can schedule a follow-up to make KV lookup backwards-compatible and add a migration job.

ashley: rolling back pool-42 now. ETA ~4m. will update when done.

perf-bot: rollback-started pool=pool-42 by=ashley

liam: logged a short playbook in ops channel with repro and mitigation steps:
```
# repro (local):
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-arch-test","input_len":512,"batch":1}' \
  https://canary-runtime.internal/predict | jq .metrics.kernel
# expected: "avx_fused_v2"
# current: "fallback_generic"
```

maya: follow-ups: (a) make kernel_picker tolerant to either key salt for 24h, (b) add automated check in rollout pipeline to detect KV key namespace changes, (c) run a short migration to repopulate salted keys for hot cohorts. assigning owners.

sophia: i'll do (a) + add unit tests for key lookup.

liam: i'll own (b) rollout check and add a test in the canary gate.

ashley: i'll coordinate rollback verification and schedule the migration window.

maya: thanks. cc @perf-team for postmortem. please add any test cases you think are missing. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: perf-alert cleared for pool=pool-42 after rollback. 95p back to baseline ~260ms

maya: marking this thread for postmortem notes. we'll also add a small lint rule in autotuner repos: changing seqlen bin boundaries must bump key-salt at the same PR.

liam: plus add a migration helper script to runtime-ops repo — fast prefix copy for hot cohorts.

sophia: pushing a small branch for tolerant lookup now, will attach PR link when ready.
